title: GMS Week 42 - Freight Finally Flinches
summary:
Main
The dry freight retreat gathered pace this week, bringing awaited relief for recycling buyers without yet producingthe ships they need. The Baltic Dry Index recorded a steep weekly fall, led by Capesizes, while recycling indications across all four destinations remained unchanged. Owners now face a less comfortable outlook for larger bulkers, but one week's correction cannot overturn months of profitable trading.
